Initial release of smyx-vaccination-reminder-analysis.

- Enables pet vaccination due/overdue reminders using AI facial recognition from pet images or videos.
- Automatically checks vaccination records and suggests re-vaccination if overdue (default cycle: 11 months).
- Supports use in hospital registration, boarding center check-in, and insurance underwriting.
- Strict open-id (user identity) validation enforced before any analysis or report lookup.
- Outputs only database-comparison results—no medical advice provided.
- Includes automatic, table-formatted display of historical report queries via cloud API (with Markdown links).
